cohort: 423 mothers with infants less than six months old in Motta town, East Gojjam, Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia
finding: The prevalence of timely initiation of breastfeeding was 78.8%, and independent predictors of timely initiation included giving birth in a health institution, vaginal delivery, and avoidance of prelacteal feeding.
mod_finding: Mothers who birthed vaginally were more likely to initiate breastfeeding early.
